messages:
maya: Heads-up — noticed a perf regression on paged-attn after the kernel-selector change on canary. 95p token latency spiked ~2x when KV pager started evicting hot slots.

raj: repro steps? which canary, model, and load shape?

maya: canary=canary-4, model=redwood/flashv2-8k, load=steady 600qps with 1.2k token avg. repro with `./bench/paged_attn_micro --qps 600 --seq 1024` locally. quick perf summary below.

maya: perf dump (nvprof-ish):
```
nvprof: top 5 kernels by time:
  flash_attn_fwd  48.2%
  fused_matmul   21.1%
  kv_page_fetch  12.9%
  fallback_attn   9.6%  <-- increased after page faults
  memcpy_h2d       8.2%
```

linda: hmm, `fallback_attn` jumping up during paging sounds like kernel-selector preferring fallback path when free slab < threshold. I remember we set sticky_kernel to prefer flash only if contiguous KV pages >= 16. If paging churn drops that, selector flips.

noah: I ran a quick bench with synthetic churn (kv hotset=0.6) and saw similar:
- baseline (old selector): 95p=48ms, throughput=580 qps
- new selector: 95p=112ms, throughput=420 qps

noah: attach short flamegraph (uploaded): https://redwood-artifacts/internal/flamegraphs/pagedattn-canary4.svg

perf-bot: auto-detected metrics for thread 3299998888 -> new metric alerts created: kv.page_fault_rate, kernel.selector_switches

raj: can we confirm allocator behavior? are we seeing fragmentation that causes smaller contiguous runs and triggers fallback? Any allocator counters?

maya: allocator stats from canary: `free_runs=3, avg_run_len=7, slab_compactions=12/hr, page_frag_ratio=0.42`. Also saw frequent `page_prefault_misses`.

linda: that avg_run_len=7 is the problem. Flash kernel needs longer runs to launch fused kernels efficiently. Two quick mitigations: 1) relax sticky_kernel threshold from 16->8 for moderate fragmentation, 2) opportunistic compaction on low load. Both low-risk.

raj: I'd prefer #1 first (config tweak) to avoid extra compaction IO. Can we A/B config on canary?

maya: patch to override threshold in runtime config: 
```
# runtime.conf snippet
[paged_attention]
min_contig_for_flash = 8  # was 16
enable_opportunistic_compact = false
```

maya: will push to canary-4 in 5m.

deploy-bot: rollout started: canary-4 config apply (maya).

noah: parallel microbench run after config change (5 min post): 95p=52ms, throughput=570 qps. page_fault_rate down ~60%.

linda: great. We should still consider adding a metric that correlates kernel choice to run_len distribution so selector can auto-tune. Proposed metric names: `kernel_choice.hist.contig_run_len` and `alloc.slab_compaction_trigger_count`.

raj: agree. Also add an endpoint in /debug to dump current run map for a shard — will help postmortems. Keep compaction off by default.

maya: created follow-up ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RIN-2241 "auto-tune kernel selector based on contig run histogram" and assigned to eng-runtime.

perf-bot: note: scheduled regression check for next nightly bench to ensure no regressions with min_contig_for_flash=8.

maya: thanks all. I'll leave canary under observation for 2 hours and report back. :thumbsup:
